svg.title: TWI six-method development comparison
svg.text: TWI: six methods, one shared photo panel
Tyre-wear indicator comparison | Provisional development label agreement
Same 9 photos: 5 bad + 4 good. Training protocols differ. Reviews count as not correct.
Raw binary-output coverage: 8/9 for each Luna method (1 review); 9/9 for the other four.
Separate grouped/development results • different protocols; Luna uses refined retrospective prompts.
ROUGH AZURE COSTS · USD RETAIL ESTIMATES
COMPUTE: one synthetic-photo Azure cold smoke per local method (8.62 / 8.64 / 11.43 s), including startup; not a representative average. 2 vCPU + 4 GiB × East
API COHORTS DIFFER FROM THE 9-PHOTO ACCURACY PANEL: Luna mean = 25 submitted cases (22 binary + 2 review + 1 duplicate); GPT fine-tune mean =
actual 9 evaluation calls. Cache tokens observed: 0.
* LUNA: short/long context retail tiers give ranges; exact tier boundary and Decisions charging semantics remain partly unresolved. Indicative estimates, not a final
SHARED APP: one 2-vCPU / 4-GiB dashboard allocation, also needed for cloud methods. 30-day compute: ~$46.66 fully idle to $155.52 fully active, before free
grants. Not three hosts; do not add processing compute twice.
EXCLUDES: Storage, ACR Premium, private endpoints/DNS, logs, networking and other infrastructure; also local training, discounts/tax. Shared-app compute is
separate from API and GPT model hosting.
GPT FINE-TUNE: + $1.70/hour model hosting • $31.98 one-off training
Hosting applies while deployed, even idle. Example excludes shared-app infrastructure and training.
Serving heads refit all 22; not scored here.
Equivalent checks, not numbered API questions.
Is enough tread visible to assess condition?
Are grooves/raised tread relief distinct, flattened/shallow, or
Is cracking/exposed cords/torn rubber/severe damage visible?
What visible evidence supports the assessment?
What is the condition: good / bad / review?
One prompt → structured observations + final condition.
Is enough tread face clear to see groove/raised relief or wear?
Partial/oblique views suffice if clear. Sidewall/rim alone and fully
obscuring mud do not. No exact depth measurement is required.
Is cracking, exposed cords, torn rubber or severe visible tyre
damage clearly present? Do not confuse tread grooves, mud or
What is the visible condition: good / bad / review?
Condition rubric (summary): good = clear raised relief/grooves without
wear/damage; bad = flattened/bald/shallow-looking wear or damage;
review = obscured, sidewall-only, or conflicting evidence.
Judge visible condition, not tread design alone; do not infer millimetres or TWI verification.
Tiny, previously explored archive: 25 photos → 24 unique (22 binary + 2 review); preliminary non-expert labels.
Hypothesized groups are unconfirmed. 9/9 is not population accuracy. OOF = out-of-fold.
